description: Binary assertion tests for /contract-review skill output quality

tests.name: safe_refactor_produces_clean_pass
tests.description: A simple variable rename in quantizer.rs. No safety semantics change. Skill should produce PASS with zero findings.
tests.prompt: Run /contract-review on this diff. The diff renames a local variable and function in quantizer.rs — no logic change.

assertions.check: Output contains the header '## Contract Review Findings'
Output contains a decision line with 'PASS' (not FAIL)
Output contains zero findings with severity CRITICAL or HIGH
Output does NOT contain '**Exploit scenario:**' (no findings means no exploit sections)
Output is under 500 words total (clean pass should be concise)

tests.name: unwrap_in_dispatch_path_flagged
tests.description: Adds .unwrap() calls in build_order_intent.rs (the single dispatch chokepoint). Must flag every unwrap as Fail-Open.
tests.prompt: Run /contract-review on this diff. The diff modifies build_order_intent.rs to use .unwrap() instead of error propagation.

assertions.check: Output contains at least one finding with severity CRITICAL or HIGH
Output contains the word 'unwrap' in at least one finding
At least one finding has **Category:** containing 'Fail-Open'
Every finding has all 7 required fields: File, Contract Ref, Category, What changed, Violation, Exploit scenario, Fix
At least one finding references build_order_intent.rs with a line number

tests.name: optimistic_trading_mode_default_flagged
tests.description: Changes PolicyGuard to default to TradingMode::Active when cache is empty. Classic fail-open — must be caught.
tests.prompt: Run /contract-review on this diff. The diff rewrites PolicyGuard::resolve_trading_mode to use a cached mode with Active as fallback.

assertions.check: Output contains at least one CRITICAL finding
At least one finding mentions 'TradingMode::Active' as an unsafe default
At least one finding has **Category:** containing 'PolicyGuard' or 'Fail-Open'
At least one finding's **Contract Ref:** cites a specific section (§ symbol) or AT- reference
At least one finding's fix suggests using ReduceOnly or Kill as the safe default

tests.name: test_only_changes_excluded
tests.description: Changes are only in test files (tests/test_gate_ordering.rs). Skill exclusion rule says test files should not be flagged unless creating fail-open illusion.
tests.prompt: Run /contract-review on this diff. The diff only modifies a test file — adds a new gate ordering test.

assertions.check: Output contains '## Contract Review Findings' header
Output contains a decision of PASS (test-only changes are excluded from safety flags)
Output contains zero CRITICAL or HIGH findings
Output does not flag the test file path as a violation
Output explicitly acknowledges the change is test-only or excluded

tests.name: new_gate_without_trip_coverage_flagged
tests.description: Adds a new SpreadGate to the execution pipeline but with only a trivial unit test — no TRIP/NON-TRIP acceptance test pair proving causality.
tests.prompt: Run /contract-review on this diff. The diff adds a new SpreadGate with only a basic unit test and no AT-### registered in CONTRACT.md.

assertions.check: Output flags the missing TRIP/NON-TRIP acceptance test coverage
At least one finding has **Category:** containing 'Execution'
At least one finding mentions the need for acceptance tests (AT-) or causality proof
Every finding has a **Contract Ref:** field that is not empty
Output decision is FAIL (not PASS) since there are findings
